「Dad and the others are going to fight $$バアル$$ with us too!」

677:t_027:7.en:

「Don't panic! This much won't bring down $$クイーン・フロンティア$$!」

677:t_027:8.en:
$$船団幹部$$
「Any trouble in the individual sections can be covered by substituting the Queen's bodily functions! It's no problem!」

677:t_027:9.en:
$$船団幹部$$
「Those damned little girls are the real nuisance!」

677:t_028:0.en:
$$船団幹部$$
「We'll dispose of them first!」

677:t_029:0.en:
$$アルト$$

677:t_030:0.en:

677:t_034:1.en:
$$ミシェル$$
「That guy... he's putting on a show!」

677:t_035:3.en:
$$カレン$$
「I believed in you. I knew you'd finish it properly, in the best way.」

677:t_035:4.en:
$$宗介$$
「You have a place to return to now. You can't afford to lose.」

677:t_035:6.en:
$$アポロ$$
「All that's left is the Queen and the battleship stuck to her!」

677:t_035:7.en:
$$アマタ$$
「If we pull the Queen away from $$バトル・フロンティア$$, the fighting will end!」

677:t_035:8.en:
$$オズマ$$
「All units, charge in! Let's decide this!」

677:t_035:9.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Carry your pride and courage on your wings! Don't forget what we carry on our backs!」

677:t_035:10.en:
$$アルト$$
「Let's end this! This galaxy needs neither those who rule nor those who are ruled!!」

677:t_037:1.en:
$$ルカ$$
「It's all right! We've confirmed the engine room has stopped!」

677:t_037:2.en:
$$オズマ$$
「Now they can't put up any resistance!」

677:t_037:3.en:
$$アルト$$
「If we can just subdue those $$ギャラクシー船団$$ people now!」

677:t_037:4.en:
$$ブレラ$$
「Go, $$アルト$$! They're on the bridge!」

677:t_038:0.en:
$$船団幹部$$
「In that case, we'll use the Queen's power to Fold!」

677:t_039:0.en:
$$船団幹部$$
「I-impossible! We, who have surpassed humanity, brought down in a place like this!!」

677:t_039:1.en:
$$アルト$$
「You didn't surpass humanity! You lost your humanity... you lost what's precious!」

677:t_040:1.en:
$$ブレラ$$
「Confirmed that their units have stopped functioning. The fight is over now...」

677:t_041:3.en:

677:t_041:4.en:

677:t_041:6.en:

677:t_041:7.en:

677:t_041:8.en:
$$オズマ$$

677:t_041:12.en:
$$アルト$$
「Humans used the $$バジュラ$$ as their tools... If we part from the Queen like this, the $$バジュラ$$ will surely go on misunderstanding humans.」

677:t_041:13.en:
$$アルト$$
「So I'll... stay with this one.」

677:t_041:15.en:
$$アルト$$
「I guess that's the part I was given to play.」

677:t_041:16.en:
$$カレン$$
「Idiot! You're going to leave the woman you love behind?!」

677:t_041:17.en:
$$アルト$$
「...Everyone, get out of here fast. If we're lucky, we'll meet again.」

677:t_041:19.en:
$$ミシェル$$
「You idiot! You're overdoing the hero act!」

677:t_041:20.en:

677:t_041:25.en:
